about_001:
From southern Kyushu,
building Japan's AI computing foundation.
about_002: Kai Shin Digital Infrastructure Inc. is a company that develops and operates AI data centers in Satsumasendai, Kagoshima Prefecture.
about_004:
In Kagoshima, blessed with decarbonized power,
a computing foundation that runs on locally produced energy.
about_005: While the spread of AI is driving rapid growth in demand for computing resources, data centers remain concentrated in metropolitan areas, and reconciling power supply with decarbonization is a challenge. We answer this challenge by building large-scale data centers in Kagoshima, and together with the prefecture, the city and Kyushu Electric Power we will realize a GW-class concentration of AI infrastructure in southern Kyushu.
about_007: Procure 100% of the electricity we use from decarbonized sources — centered on nuclear, geothermal and hydro within the prefecture — with the majority secured from in-prefecture generation.
about_009: Take root in local industry through local hiring, talent development and local procurement.
about_011: Provide AI computing resources to Kyushu's industrial clusters in manufacturing, semiconductors, logistics and more.
about_013: Integrated design of power, cooling and procurement with GW scale in view
about_015: Power infrastructure that starts from extra-high-voltage receiving and expands in stages to GW class as demand grows.
about_017: High-density housing of high-heat AI servers, targeting a PUE of 1.2 or below.
about_019: Early operation on a short schedule, with phased expansion in line with demand.
about_021: Integrating Taiwan's ODM and investment networks with Japan's EPC and operational capabilities.
